mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates an active monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential housing starts and consumer spending (as measured by real sales) indicate a weakening demand cycle that triggers a negative equity market reaction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production, the manufacturing sector contraction signals reduced corporate output and profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in a late-cycle economic regime.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO is declining.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the central bank to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real sales (RSAFS) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both unemployment rate and non-farm payrolls signal a labor market mismatch where job growth outpaces demand, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both UNRATE and PAYEMS rise by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers higher discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.
